controls: Audit damaged initial HP, same-town membership, completed state and harvested repair supply before issuing commands.
Disable combat, regeneration, construction and training; verify the repair mark was accepted.
Pair automatic and marked service with disabled-service, zero-supply, full-HP and foreign-town controls.
Repeat ordinary-building priority groups and defence ordering with multiple targets; track unused supply and HP caps.
No observed repair with an empty resource map does not establish the repair rate; use a separately audited positive-supply repeat.
